stories.title: ICE arrests 115 people in recent 'targeted enforcement operation' in Indiana
stories.summary: "If you come into our country illegally and break our laws, we will find you, we will arrest you and we will deport you," ICE said in its release.

stories.title: NIPSCO internal review blames storm response on inconsistent operations
stories.summary: The company recorded more than 350,000 outages following an Aug. 11 derecho and subsequent storms, with winds reaching nearly 100 miles per hour in Lake County.

stories.title: 8 rescue dogs graduate as police K-9s in Plainfield
stories.summary: The graduating class is the largest in the two-year history of Redemption Ranch, a nonprofit based in Plainfield. The dogs come from across the country.

stories.title: Volunteers share warm Thanksgiving meals, holiday cheer
stories.summary: The Edna Martin Christian Center and the VFW on English Avenue held annual Thanksgiving events Tuesday to help those in need in the Indianapolis community.

stories.title: Greenwood Fire Department opens new station, training tower
stories.summary: The new fire station also has a dedicated logistics building and a firefighter training tower.

stories.title: Indianapolis Public Schools offering family information meetings to discuss changes for next school year
stories.summary: The meetings will be held Dec. 1-3 at various IPS schools.

stories.title: Indiana comptroller-elect Bailey names transition team ahead of taking office Jan. 1
stories.summary: Democratic State Comptroller-elect Jessica Bailey picked one of her campaign advisors and released a list of 14 transition advisers.

stories.title: 35 people charged federally as part of 'Operation Circle City Shield' in Indianapolis
stories.summary: U.S. Attorney Tom Wheeler announced Thursday that 35 people have been charged with federal firearms, drug trafficking and other offenses as part of the operation.

stories.title: Sen. Todd Young seeks answers from Nvidia CEO following reinstatement
stories.summary: Young says Congress has questions of its own about Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia and isn't ruling out changes to U.S. chip export restrictions.

stories.title: CONGRATS! Tyrese and Jade Haliburton expecting a baby in the spring
stories.summary: The couple announced her pregnancy on Instagram Tuesday.

stories.title: 'It's just the love that Gas City shows' | Donations pour in after deadly Grant County house fire
stories.summary: Residents of Gas City and surrounding communities are filling City Hall with donations for a family that lost two young children in a house fire on Sunday.

stories.title: 'If I end this now ... hopefully it doesn't come out publicly' | Ex-IMPD officer sentenced to 24 years for child molestation
stories.summary: The investigation began July 9, 2025, when a 17-year-old told her father that she had been sexually abused by a family friend for approximately nine years.
